# Part 1: Monte Carlo simulation

```{r}

set.seed(42)

rho_vals <- c(0.25, 0.50, 0.95)
p_vals   <- c(10, 100, 200)
n        <- 50
rep      <- 200

# Store simulated datasets
results <- list()

for (rho in rho_vals) {
  for (p in p_vals) {

    # Covariance matrix
    Sigma <- rho * matrix(1, p, p) + (1 - rho) * diag(p)
    L <- chol(Sigma)

    sims <- vector("list", rep)

    # True beta
    beta <- rep(0, p)
    beta[1:10] <- 3

    for (r in 1:rep) {

      # Simulate X
      Z <- matrix(rnorm(n * p), n, p)
      X_raw <- Z %*% L

      # Simulate Y = Xβ + ε
      eps <- rnorm(n)
      y <- X_raw %*% beta

      sims[[r]] <- list(X = X_raw, y = as.vector(y + eps))
    }

    results[[paste0("rho_", rho, "_p_", p)]] <- sims
  }
}

```

```{r}


library(glmnet)
library(doParallel)

# Use all available cores
cl <- makeCluster(detectCores() - 1)
registerDoParallel(cl)

results_all <- list()

# Loop over combinations
for (key in names(results)) {

  sims <- results[[key]]
  p <- ncol(sims[[1]]$X)
  beta <- rep(0, p)
  beta[1:10] <- 3

  # Parallel over repetitions
  errors_list <- foreach(r = seq_along(sims), .packages = "glmnet") %dopar% {

    X <- scale(sims[[r]]$X)
    y <- sims[[r]]$y

    res <- list()

    # ---- Ridge (alpha = 0) ----
    ridge_cv <- cv.glmnet(x = X, y = y, alpha = 0)
    ridge_hat <- as.vector(coef(ridge_cv, s = "lambda.min"))[-1]
    res$ridge <- list(
      sq_error   = sum((ridge_hat - beta)^2),
      pred_error = sum((X %*% (ridge_hat - beta))^2),
      cv_fit     = ridge_cv
    )

    # ---- LASSO (alpha = 1) ----
    lasso_cv <- cv.glmnet(x = X, y = y, alpha = 1)

    # lambda.min
    lasso_min_hat <- as.vector(coef(lasso_cv, s = "lambda.min"))[-1]
    res$lasso_min <- list(
      sq_error   = sum((lasso_min_hat - beta)^2),
      pred_error = sum((X %*% (lasso_min_hat - beta))^2),
      cv_fit     = lasso_cv
    )

    # lambda.1se
    lasso_1se_hat <- as.vector(coef(lasso_cv, s = "lambda.1se"))[-1]
    res$lasso_1se <- list(
      sq_error   = sum((lasso_1se_hat - beta)^2),
      pred_error = sum((X %*% (lasso_1se_hat - beta))^2),
      cv_fit     = lasso_cv
    )

    # ---- Elastic Net (alpha = 0.5) ----
    enet_cv <- cv.glmnet(x = X, y = y, alpha = 0.5)
    enet_hat <- as.vector(coef(enet_cv, s = "lambda.min"))[-1]
    res$elastic <- list(
      sq_error   = sum((enet_hat - beta)^2),
      pred_error = sum((X %*% (enet_hat - beta))^2),
      cv_fit     = enet_cv
    )

    res
  }

  # Initialize storage for this combination
  results_all[[key]] <- list()

  # Loop over methods to extract errors, averages, coef paths, and CV curves
  for (method in c("ridge", "lasso_min", "lasso_1se", "elastic")) {

    # Extract errors
    sq_errors <- sapply(errors_list, function(x) x[[method]]$sq_error)
    pred_errors <- sapply(errors_list, function(x) x[[method]]$pred_error)

    # Save last repetition's cv_fit for coef path and CV curve
    last_cv_fit <- errors_list[[length(sims)]][[method]]$cv_fit

    results_all[[key]][[method]] <- list(
      sq_errors      = sq_errors,
      avg_sq_error   = mean(sq_errors),
      pred_errors    = pred_errors,
      avg_pred_error = mean(pred_errors),
      coef_path      = coef(last_cv_fit$glmnet.fit),
      lambda_seq     = last_cv_fit$glmnet.fit$lambda,
      lambda_selected= last_cv_fit$lambda.min,
      cv_curve       = data.frame(
        lambda = last_cv_fit$lambda,
        cvm    = last_cv_fit$cvm,
        cvsd   = last_cv_fit$cvsd
      )
    )
  }
}

stopCluster(cl)

```

```{r}
plot_coef_paths <- function(results_all, method) {
  for (key in names(results_all)) {
    res <- results_all[[key]][[method]]

    coef_mat <- as.matrix(res$coef_path)
    coef_mat_no_int <- coef_mat[-1, ]  # drop intercept
    n_coef <- nrow(coef_mat_no_int)

    # Reorder columns so lambda increases
    ord <- order(res$lambda_seq)
    lambda <- res$lambda_seq[ord]
    coef_mat_no_int <- coef_mat_no_int[, ord]

    colors <- c(rep("red", min(10, n_coef)), rep("gray", n_coef - 10))

    matplot(
      log(lambda), t(coef_mat_no_int), type = "l", lty = 1,
      col = colors, xlab = "log(lambda)", ylab = "Coefficients",
      main = paste("Coefficient Paths:", key, "-", method)
    )

    legend("topright",
           legend = c("True beta 1-10", "Zero beta"),
           col = c("red", "gray"), lty = 1, cex = 0.8)
  }
}

plot_cv_curves <- function(results_all, method) {
  for (key in names(results_all)) {
    res <- results_all[[key]][[method]]

    cv_df <- res$cv_curve
    cv_df <- cv_df[order(cv_df$lambda), ]
    lambda <- cv_df$lambda

    plot(
      log(lambda), cv_df$cvm, type = "l", lwd = 2,
      xlab = "log(lambda)", ylab = "CV Error",
      main = paste("CV Curve:", key, "-", method)
    )

    # ±1 SE ribbon
    lines(log(lambda), cv_df$cvm + cv_df$cvsd, lty = 2, col = "gray")
    lines(log(lambda), cv_df$cvm - cv_df$cvsd, lty = 2, col = "gray")
  }
}

```

```{r}
plot_coef_paths(results_all, method = "ridge")
plot_cv_curves(results_all, method = "ridge")
```

```{r}
plot_coef_paths(results_all, method = "lasso_min")
plot_cv_curves(results_all, method = "lasso_min")
```

```{r}
plot_coef_paths(results_all, method = "lasso_1se")
plot_cv_curves(results_all, method = "lasso_1se")
```

```{r}
plot_coef_paths(results_all, method = "elastic")
plot_cv_curves(results_all, method = "elastic")
```

```{r}
library(knitr)

methods <- c("ridge", "lasso_min", "lasso_1se", "elastic")
summary_tables <- list()

# Loop over all combinations
for (key in names(results_all)) {
  
  # Prepare empty summary data frame
  summary_df <- data.frame(
    Method = methods,
    E_beta = NA,
    E_Xbeta = NA
  )
  
  # Loop over methods
  for (i in seq_along(methods)) {
    method <- methods[i]
    
    # Average Eβ (squared estimation error)
    summary_df$E_beta[i]  <- mean(results_all[[key]][[method]]$sq_error)
    
    # Average EXβ (prediction error)
    summary_df$E_Xbeta[i] <- mean(results_all[[key]][[method]]$pred_error)
  }
  
  summary_tables[[key]] <- summary_df
  
  # Print nicely with kable
  cat("\n====================================\n")
  cat("Results for:", key, "\n")
  print(kable(summary_df, digits = 3, caption = paste("Averaged Squared Errors:", key)))
}


```

# Part 2: Diabetes data

```{r}
diabetes <- read.csv("diabetesdata.csv")
```

```{r}
model <- lm(Y ~ ., data = diabetes)

# Extract coefficients
coef_table <- summary(model)$coefficients

# Display coefficients as a kable
kable(coef_table, digits = 4, caption = "OLS Regression Coefficients")

# Extract key model statistics
model_stats <- data.frame(
  Statistic = c("Residual Standard Error", "Adjusted R-squared", "Multiple R-squared", "F-statistic"),
  Value = c(summary(model)$sigma,
            summary(model)$adj.r.squared,
            summary(model)$r.squared,
            summary(model)$fstatistic[1])
)

# Display model summary statistics as a kable
kable(model_stats, digits = 4, caption = "OLS Model Summary Statistics")
```

```{r}
# Load necessary libraries
library(ggplot2)
library(reshape2)

# Load data
diabetes <- read.csv("diabetesdata.csv")

# Separate predictors and response
X <- as.matrix(diabetes[, -which(names(diabetes) == "Y")])
y <- diabetes$Y


# Cross-validation to select lambda
set.seed(42)
cv_ridge <- cv.glmnet(X, y, alpha = 0, standardize = FALSE)

# Use the same lambda grid as in cv.glmnet to fit the model
ridge_model <- glmnet(X, y, alpha = 0, standardize = FALSE, lambda = cv_ridge$glmnet.fit$lambda)
```

```{r}
coef_mat <- as.matrix(ridge_model$beta)
coef_df <- data.frame(lambda = ridge_model$lambda, t(coef_mat))
coef_melt <- melt(coef_df, id.vars = "lambda")

ggplot(coef_melt, aes(x = log(lambda), y = value, color = variable)) +
  geom_line(size = 1) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = log(cv_ridge$lambda.min), linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  labs(x = "log(lambda)", y = "Coefficient",
       title = "Ridge Regression Coefficient Paths",
       subtitle = "Red dashed line indicates lambda.min") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.title = element_blank())
```

```{r}
# Prepare CV data
cv_df <- data.frame(
  lambda = cv_ridge$lambda,
  cvm = cv_ridge$cvm,   # mean CV error
  cvup = cv_ridge$cvup, # upper SE
  cvlo = cv_ridge$cvlo  # lower SE
)

# Plot CV curve
ggplot(cv_df, aes(x = log(lambda), y = cvm)) +
  geom_line(size = 1, color = "blue") +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = cvlo, ymax = cvup), alpha = 0.2) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = log(cv_ridge$lambda.min), linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  labs(
    x = "log(lambda)",
    y = "Mean CV Error",
    title = "Cross-Validation Curve for Ridge Regression",
    subtitle = "Red dashed = lambda.min"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()


```

```{r}

lasso_mod <- glmnet(X, y, alpha = 1, standardize = FALSE)


set.seed(42)
cv_lasso_mod <- cv.glmnet(X, y, alpha = 1, standardize = FALSE)

# Best lambda (lambda.min)
lambda_best <- cv_lasso_mod$lambda.min
lambda_best


coef_lasso <- coef(cv_lasso_mod, s = "lambda.min")

# Convert to data frame for reporting
coef_lasso_df <- data.frame(
  Variable = rownames(coef_lasso),
  Coefficient = as.numeric(coef_lasso)
)

# Display coefficients as a kable
kable(coef_lasso_df, digits = 4, caption = "LASSO Coefficients at lambda.min")

# ----------------------------
# 4. Coefficient Path Plot
# ----------------------------
coef_mat <- as.matrix(lasso_mod$beta)
coef_df <- data.frame(lambda = lasso_mod$lambda, t(coef_mat))
coef_melt <- melt(coef_df, id.vars = "lambda")

ggplot(coef_melt, aes(x = log(lambda), y = value, color = variable)) +
  geom_line(size = 1) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = log(lambda_best), linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  labs(x = "log(lambda)", y = "Coefficient",
       title = "LASSO Regression Coefficient Paths",
       subtitle = "Red dashed line indicates lambda.min") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.title = element_blank())

```
